title: Wales today
mapAria: Map of the 22 council areas of Wales, coloured by {lens}. Use the list of council areas after the map to move between them with the keyboard.
lens.hint: Open a goal to see its measures.
key.label: What the colours mean
key.higherBetter: Higher is better on this measure.
key.lowerBetter: Lower is better on this measure.
key.noDirection: Neither higher nor lower is better. It is here for context.
kbd.label: Council areas, in map order
kbd.help: Arrow keys move to the nearest council area in that direction. Enter opens its figures.
panel.caption: Main figures for {name}
panel.visitHead: You can visit this place in the game
panel.visit.rhondda: In the game you can visit the Rhondda. You choose which coal tips to make safe first. It uses real records of tips, homes, schools and flood zones.
panel.visit.bethesda: In the game you can visit Bethesda and Dyffryn Ogwen. You decide who the old slate quarry is for now: homes, work, Welsh, visitors or the river.
panel.official: Official figures, from the latest open release.
explorer.title: Compare the council areas
explorer.columnsHint: Open a goal and tick the measures to show.
explorer.sortHint: Press a column heading to sort by it.
explorer.caption: The 22 council areas by the measures you chose
scatter.aria: Dot chart of the 22 council areas: {x} along the bottom, {y} up the side
scatter.note: Each square is a council area. The open square is Wales. Dots that sit together do not prove one thing causes the other.
foot.honest: Real figures from the latest open data. A thinking tool, not a forecast. Not an official view.
foot.attribution: Boundaries: ONS (OGL). Terrain: AWS Terrain Tiles. Railways: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Figures: ONS, Welsh Government, DESNZ, DWP, DfT, NRW, Forestry Commission, Cadw, RCAHMW (OGL).
short.coal_tips_cd: Coal tips, highest risk (C and D)
short.welsh_at_home_pupils: Pupils who speak Welsh at home
short.gas_use_median: Gas used by a typical home
unit.pop_change: Per cent change over ten years
unit.welsh_speakers: Per cent of residents aged 3 and over
unit.deprivation: Per cent of small neighbourhoods in the poorest fifth, by the Welsh deprivation index (WIMD)
unit.deprivation_10: Per cent of small neighbourhoods in the poorest tenth, by the Welsh deprivation index (WIMD)
unit.gva_head: Value of goods and services made, per person, in pounds (GVA per head)
unit.employment: Per cent of people aged 16 to 64
unit.earnings: Pounds a week, full-time, where people live
unit.affordability: A typical house price divided by a typical year’s pay
unit.emissions_head: Tonnes of greenhouse gas a person (t CO2e)
unit.renewables: Kilowatts of clean power built, per person
unit.flood_exposure: Homes at risk for every 100 homes. A home at risk from two kinds of flood counts twice.
unit.greenspace_access: Per cent of homes within 300 m
unit.gp_travel_public: Minutes for a return trip to a GP by bus or train
unit.coal_tips_cd: Tips in the two highest risk groups, C and D
unit.gdhi_head: Pounds a person a year that households can spend or save after tax and benefits
unit.claimant_rate: Per cent of people aged 16 to 64, average over 12 months
unit.inactivity: Per cent aged 16 to 64 not in work or looking for work, including students and carers
unit.self_employed: Per cent of people in work aged 16 to 64 who work for themselves
unit.enterprises_10k: Active businesses for every 10,000 people aged 16 to 64
unit.business_births: New businesses started in the year, as a per cent of all active businesses
unit.level4: Per cent of people aged 18 to 64 qualified to degree level or above (level 4+)
unit.jobs_density: Jobs based in the area for each resident aged 16 to 64
unit.earnings_workplace: Pounds a week, full-time, for jobs based in the area
unit.employment_deprivation: Per cent of working-age people on out-of-work benefits or too ill to work, Welsh deprivation index (WIMD)
unit.business_survival: Per cent of businesses started in 2022 still going in 2025
unit.no2_pop: Yearly average where people live, in micrograms per cubic metre (modelled)
unit.pm25_pop: Yearly average where people live, in micrograms per cubic metre (modelled)
unit.ndvi_green: How green the land around homes looks from space, a score from 0 to 1
unit.noise_exposed: Per cent of people living with loud road, rail or industry noise
unit.ancient_woodland: Per cent of land under woods that have stood since at least 1600
unit.woodland_cover: Per cent of land covered by woods of about half a hectare or more
unit.sssi_land: Per cent of land that is a Site of Special Scientific Interest
unit.protected_landscape: Per cent of land in a National Park or a National Landscape (once called AONB)
unit.river_good_status: Per cent of river length in good health, by the water quality rules
unit.healthy_life_exp: Years a newborn baby can expect to live in good health
unit.premature_deaths: Deaths before age 75 for every 100,000 people, adjusted for age
unit.bad_health: Per cent of residents who say their health is bad or very bad
unit.disabled_limited_lot: Per cent of residents whose daily life is limited a lot by ill health or disability
unit.gp_chronic: Per cent of people with a long-term condition on GP records
unit.gp_mental_health: Per cent of people with a mental health condition on GP records
unit.cancer_incidence: New cancer cases a year for every 100,000 people
unit.low_birth_weight: Per cent of babies born weighing under 2.5 kg
unit.immunised_age4: Per cent of children with all their routine jabs by their fourth birthday
unit.suicide_rate: Deaths by suicide a year for every 100,000 people, adjusted for age
unit.drug_deaths: Deaths from drug poisoning a year for every 100,000 people, adjusted for age
unit.unpaid_care_20h: Per cent of residents aged 5 and over giving 20 or more hours of unpaid care a week
unit.child_low_income: Per cent of children under 16 in families on well below the typical income, before housing costs
unit.free_school_meals: Per cent of pupils who can get free school meals because of low family income
unit.older_income_deprivation: Per cent of people aged 60 and over on means-tested benefits, Welsh deprivation index (WIMD)
unit.income_deprivation: Per cent of people on means-tested benefits or a very low income, Welsh deprivation index (WIMD)
unit.low_pay_hourly: Pounds an hour: one in five full-time workers earns less than this
unit.hh_deprived_2plus: Per cent of households short in two or more of: education, work, health, housing
unit.daf_payments: Emergency cash and help grants paid in a year, for every 1,000 people
unit.second_homes: Second homes for every 100 homes that pay council tax
unit.empty_homes: Empty homes for every 100 homes that pay council tax
unit.social_housing: Per cent of all homes rented from a council or housing association
unit.temp_accommodation: Homeless people in temporary housing at the end of a typical month, for every 10,000 people
unit.new_homes: New homes finished each year, for every 1,000 homes already there (3 year average)
unit.overcrowding: Per cent of households with fewer bedrooms than they need
unit.slow_broadband: Per cent of homes that cannot get superfast broadband
unit.burglary: Burglaries recorded by police in a year, for every 100 homes
unit.welsh_daily: Per cent of people aged 3 and over who speak Welsh every day (survey)
unit.welsh_literate: Per cent of people aged 3 and over who can speak, read and write Welsh
unit.welsh_at_home_pupils: Per cent of pupils aged 5 and over who speak Welsh at home, as their parents say
unit.welsh_medium_pupils: Per cent of pupils in Welsh-medium schools or classes
unit.welsh_medium_teachers: Per cent of teachers who teach or work through Welsh
unit.welsh_identity: Per cent of residents whose national identity is Welsh only, or Welsh and British
unit.library_travel: Minutes for a return trip to a public library by bus or train
unit.scheduled_monuments: Protected ancient monuments for every 100 square kilometres of land
unit.historic_place_names: Recorded historic place names for every square kilometre of land
unit.home_transport_emissions: Tonnes of greenhouse gas a person from homes and transport only (t CO2e)
unit.heat_pumps: Heat pumps fitted, for every 1,000 homes
unit.home_energy_efficiency: Average energy score of homes out of 100 (SAP), where higher means warmer for less
unit.gas_use_median: Kilowatt hours of gas a typical home on the gas grid uses in a year
unit.off_gas_grid: Per cent of homes with no mains gas
unit.plug_in_cars: Per cent of privately owned cars that are electric or plug-in hybrid
unit.ev_chargers: Public electric car charging points for every 100,000 people
unit.ev_chargers_rapid: Rapid public charging points (50 kW or more) for every 100,000 people
unit.drive_to_work: Per cent of people travelling to work who drive a car or van
unit.recycling_rate: Per cent of council-collected waste reused, recycled or composted
unit.residual_waste_head: Kilograms of household rubbish a person a year that is not recycled
